title: fungiforge master table (master_fungi.tsv)
description: One row per isolate: the Layer-1 -> Layer-2 handoff contract. Columns are append-only: new fungiforge versions add columns at the end, never rename or reorder existing ones. Every field may be the literal 'NA' (not measured / stage skipped); numeric fields are otherwise plain numbers, booleans are 'True'/'False'.

columns.name: sample
columns.description: isolate identifier from the samplesheet (primary key)

columns.name: compartment
columns.description: sampling compartment from the samplesheet (e.g. AIR, HUMAN, SURFACE)

columns.name: facility
columns.description: facility / site from the samplesheet

columns.name: season
columns.description: season or sampling round from the samplesheet

columns.name: species
columns.description: species call of stage 08 ('Genus sp.' when only the genus is resolved, 'unknown' when nothing matched)

columns.name: species_confidence
columns.description: confidence of the species call (high needs ITS plus an agreeing secondary locus)

columns.name: id_method
columns.description: evidence behind the call, e.g. ITS+CaM(concordant)

columns.name: qc_pass
columns.description: assembly-QC gate result (MIMAG-style: assembly present and BUSCO >= 80 %)

columns.name: busco_complete
columns.description: BUSCO/compleasm completeness (%) against the stage-05 lineage

columns.name: busco_lineage
columns.description: BUSCO lineage used in stage 05 (fungi_odb10 unless --busco_lineage)

columns.name: assembly_len
columns.description: nuclear assembly length (bp)

columns.name: n_contigs
columns.description: nuclear contig count

columns.name: ploidy
columns.description: ploidy call from nQuire on the read BAM (1 = haploid-like), NA without reads

columns.name: mating_type
columns.description: mating-type idiomorph from the Pfam MAT locus scan

columns.name: resistant_classes
columns.description: antifungal classes with a known resistance mutation, ';'-separated, 'none' when clean

columns.name: n_known_af_mutations
columns.description: count of known resistance mutations called

columns.name: cyp51A_TR
columns.description: A. fumigatus cyp51A promoter tandem repeat (TR34 / TR46 / TR46_3 / none / NA)

columns.name: novelty
columns.description: novelty verdict of stage 12

columns.name: n_bgc
columns.description: biosynthetic gene clusters detected by antiSMASH

columns.name: n_mycovirus
columns.description: mycovirus-family loci in the RVDB screen (endogenous viral element candidates; DNA-only)

columns.name: te_percent
columns.description: genome fraction masked as repeats by RepeatMasker (%)

columns.name: polish_mode
columns.description: polishing route, which sets the resistance-call confidence

columns.name: sample_verdict
columns.description: contig-level Kraken2 verdict of stage 04

columns.name: contam_removed_pct
columns.description: percentage of assembled bases dropped as contamination

columns.name: top_taxon
columns.description: most abundant taxon with its percentage (contig level, or read level for gated isolates)

columns.name: stages_failed
columns.description: every stage whose status is not ok, as stage:status, or 'none'

columns.name: gate
columns.description: 'pass', or skipped(<reason>) when a gate stopped the isolate

columns.name: read_verdict
columns.description: read-level Kraken2 triage verdict (stage 00b)

columns.name: genome_size_est
columns.description: genome size estimated by GenomeScope2 from the k-mer spectrum (bp)

columns.name: heterozygosity_pct
columns.description: heterozygosity estimated by GenomeScope2 (%)

columns.name: ploidy_hint
columns.description: haploid/diploid hint from the k-mer spectrum

columns.name: coverage
columns.description: read coverage (k-mer based, else read bases / genome size)

columns.name: id_loci_agree
columns.description: secondary loci agreeing with the ITS species, ';'-separated, 'none'

columns.name: id_flags
columns.description: identification flags (ties, discordance, unavailable loci), ';'-separated, 'none'

columns.name: mlst_st
columns.description: PubMLST scheme and sequence type, e.g. afumigatus:ST5

columns.name: busco_lineage_specific
columns.description: species-aware BUSCO lineage of stage 08b (NA when it did not run)

columns.name: busco_complete_specific
columns.description: BUSCO completeness against that lineage (%)

columns.name: resistance_read_support
columns.description: read-level support summary: confirmed:N;discordant:M;reads_only:K;insufficient:J, or assembly_only

columns.name: copy_number_flags
columns.description: target/efflux genes with a locus/genome depth ratio >= 1.8, ';'-separated, 'none'

columns.name: n_proteins
columns.description: proteins predicted by Funannotate

columns.name: pct_pfam
columns.description: percentage of proteins with a PFAM domain

columns.name: pct_go
columns.description: percentage of proteins with GO terms

columns.name: pct_eggnog
columns.description: percentage of proteins with an eggNOG orthologue

columns.name: pct_interpro
columns.description: percentage of proteins with an InterPro entry (0 unless stage 07c ran)

columns.name: annotation_training
columns.description: how prediction was trained: <augustus species>/<busco set>/genemark:<yes|no>

columns.name: n_secreted
columns.description: proteins with a signal peptide (SignalP 6)

columns.name: n_effectors
columns.description: predicted effectors among the secretome (EffectorP 3)

columns.name: n_cazymes
columns.description: proteins with a dbCAN CAZyme family assignment

columns.name: n_phibase_hits
columns.description: proteins with a PHI-base best hit (virulence-associated)

columns.name: mito_size_kb
columns.description: mitochondrial genome size (kb; longest contig when the assembler left redundant fragments)

columns.name: mito_core_genes
columns.description: core mitochondrial genes found, as n/15

columns.name: mito_circular
columns.description: true when a single mitochondrial contig closes on itself

columns.name: mito_copy_ratio
columns.description: mitochondrial read depth divided by nuclear depth

columns.name: mito_heteroplasmic_sites
columns.description: mitochondrial positions with a minor substitution allele above the platform floor

columns.name: te_ltr_pct
columns.description: genome fraction masked as LTR elements (%)

columns.name: n_genomad_virus
columns.description: viral contigs called by geNomad

columns.name: n_genomad_plasmid
columns.description: plasmid contigs called by geNomad

columns.name: n_mito_heg
columns.description: mitochondrial ORFs with a homing-endonuclease / maturase domain

columns.name: mycotoxin_clusters
columns.description: known mycotoxin clusters from KnownClusterBlast, ';'-separated, 'none'

columns.name: bioactive_clusters
columns.description: known antibiotic / other bioactive clusters, ';'-separated, 'none'

columns.name: n_bgc_mibig_hits
columns.description: BGC regions with a MIBiG best hit
